sleipnir-linq — generate Sleipnir.Client.Linq service-contract interfaces.

Usage: sleipnir-linq --discovery <url|file> [--out <path>|--stdout] [--namespace <ns>] [--base-url <url>]

  --discovery <url|file>  Discovery source (file path or http(s) URL). Default: contract.sleipnir.json
  --out <path>            Write SleipnirContracts.g.cs to this path
  --stdout                Write the generated source to stdout
  --namespace <ns>        C# namespace (default Sleipnir.Linq.Contracts)
  --base-url <url>        Base URL hint rendered into the file header
